name: vehicule-blinde-compact-pbr-v2
texture_prompt: Photorealistic near-future military compact armored vehicle. Matte olive drab and graphite armor plates, subtle chipped paint on edges, realistic dust and road grime, rubber tires, dark steel suspension and bolts, believable panel seams, restrained warning decals without readable text. PBR base color, metallic, roughness and normal maps. Preserve original geometry and UV layout. No cartoon, no added parts.
